items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: I used to work for his sister, you know, Miss Patterson, Miss Osborne.

ctx.x: Well back to Chinatown while you were talking about it, were there many joints in the neighborhood there?

Joints? Yeah. Well they had bands. They had bands not too far from that. It was, Black Gold used to be on, you know where that hotel is, Foster's Hotel? Yeah. Well that's where the Black Gold was. What's that, Seventh and La Salle? Yeah. Well, Miss Isabelle Osborne, her brother, Nick Patterson, he was a former officer in the whole eastern force, he used to have that place. And I used to work for his sister, you know, Miss Patterson, Miss Osborne. And her husband was named Alfred, and he had a son named Alfred,…

No, not necessary. Well you can if you want to. You can if you want to, but. It ain't necessary. No, it's not necessary, but I don't want to put you on the spot, you know, to have to make you play, but I'd like to hear it. Okay. We can turn the tape machine off, what do you want to do anyway? Yeah, I'll turn it off for a minute. Yeah.
